Quirk Practice Facilities.text: Quirk practice facilities are licensed gyms and halls where anyone may use a Quirk legally under supervision, and most civilians train their powers there. Cities run public ones and companies run private ones: reinforced rooms with fireproof walls, drains and padded floors, outdoor ranges outside town for large or loud Quirks, pools for water users. Certified instructors check each visitor's registered Quirk at the desk, assign a suitable room and set the session's limits. Visitors book by the hour, sign a waiver and spar only with staff present. Counselors refer children with hard-to-control powers to classes there, and hero academy applicants fill the evening slots. A Quirk used outside the booked room, in the parking lot or on the walk home, counts as public use again.
